summary.text: Sahara Hayes is a Democratic state representative from Utah House of Representatives District 32 who took office on January 1, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as grant writer.

paragraphs.text: Sahara Hayes was born in Salt Lake City, Utah.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Westminster College in 2014 and a graduate degree from the University of Utah in 2018.
She succeeded Suzanne Harrison as the representative for District 32.
